notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.notes:
This is a content update. Starting a new run is recommended, as previous runs may not apply the changes correctly.

NEW CONTENT:


 New class: Ranger. Finesse-focused and with survival abilities.

GAMEPLAY:


 You can now re-enter a location without needing to travel a few steps away if you just left.
 Dungeons are now generated with monsters at the player's CR level. This should allow for a more manageable early game while keeping the chance of higher-level dungeons as you gain levels.
 Goblin: STR 10 (from 11), DEX 12 (from 13), BaB 0 (from 1).
 Goblin Archer: STR 10 (from 11), DEX 12 (from 13), BaB 0 (from 1).
 Goblin Chieftain: Damage Die 1d4 (from 1d6).
 Goblin Patrol: STR 10 (from 11), DEX 12 (from 13), BaB 6 (from 11).
 Wolf Pack: BaB 6 (from 11), Damage Die 1d6 (from 3d6).
 Wild Boar: STR 12 (from 15), Damage Die 1d6 (from 1d8).

BUGFIXES:


 Fixed an issue where increasing CON at first level (for example with a ring of CON) would not increase max HP.
 Fixed a bug where +3 bonus rings (Ring of the Champion, Ring of the Assassin, Ring of the Troll, Ring of the Archmage, Ring of the Sage, and Ring of the Bard) would not spawn correctly and caused the inventory to break.
 Reduced the selling price of items to avoid an infinite money exploit with high Charisma. The sell value will now be at best the buy value minus one gold.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.9b
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where some map locations were occasionally not clickable.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9
notes.notes: Rewrote how items are generated. The new system should make loot much more varied at both low and high levels.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.9.202411111245
notes.notes: Fixed an issue that allowed the character sheet to be usable during travel or combat.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8
notes.notes:
UI:

 You can now zoom in and out on the map.

GAMEPLAY:

 Added new enemy: Hungry Ghost.
 Added new enemy ability: Feast of Famine.
 Reduced the chances of finding Goldstennettum's Robbers Hideout at the start.
 

BUGFIXES:

 Fixed an issue where the roll result would not display when attempting to sneak into Goldstennettum's Robbers Hideout.
 Fixed an issue where the volume settings slider would not go down to 0.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7
notes.notes:
- You now gain ability points at levels 3, 6, 9, 11, 15, and 18.
 - Adjusted the layout for the new talent selection panel when gaining a talent.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.6b
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue where the check for random encounters would trigger too frequently, sometimes causing an encounter to trigger right as another was closing, resulting in a soft lock.
 - Fixed an issue where the encounter popup could be larger than the window height.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Added SETTINGS in the main menu for volume control and windowed/fullscreen mode.
 Adjusted some combat log output to improve readability.
 Fixed a bug where the player would sometimes not die when their health reached 0 (e.g., from the Will-o-Wisp's Drain Ability).
 Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented spells from being cast in combat.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5b
notes.notes: You can now filter what you see on the map between landmarks, dungeons, and settlements.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.notes:
This is a content update. Starting a new run is recommended, as previous runs may not apply the changes correctly.


 Chapter 4 map travel now has a price (keep searching for other options if the cost is too high).
 New talents can be gained at levels 4, 8, 12, and 16.
 New talents added: Vitality, Luck of Heroes.
 New advanced talents added: Great Strength, Great Dexterity, Great Constitution, Great Intelligence, Great Wisdom, Great Charisma (cannot be selected at level 1).
 Toughness now increases HP by 2 per level instead of a one-time increase of 4 at character creation.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.notes:
This is a new content patch. Starting a new run is recommended, as runs from previous versions may not work as intended or apply the new changes properly.


 Added a subtitle based on the rolled quest hook to the master quest intro to make it easier to identify the master quest for that run.
 You can now choose the main story theme during character creation. (Note: story preamble, nemesis, and hooks are still randomized.)
 Added new nemesis and new story themes for the master quest.
 Added 3 new talents: Spell Focus (Arcane), Spell Focus (Divine), and Toughness.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.3b
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where selling an item would calculate the price of the first item in your backpack, selling at 0 GP if empty.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where the Lich and the Fae would not roll as often as other nemeses.
 Fixed an issue where the option to sneak into Goldstennettum's Robbers' hideout was not working.
 Reduced the damage of Goldstennettum's Robbers (they still shouldn't be attacked head-on at level 1, but they are less likely to one-shot you now).
 Fixed an issue where a random encounter could trigger right when you reach a destination, causing a soft lock.
 Fixed an issue where the nemesis would sometimes not spawn in its lair in the final chapter.
 Fixed some minor descriptions and text.
